desc: Derive the marginal-cost formula: the k-th unit of product i costs P_i*(2k-1), so for threshold X, k_i = (floor(X/P_i)+1)//2.
Implement O(N) predicate affordable(X) with k_i = (X//P_i + 1)//2 and early break when total_cost > M.
Binary search the largest X in [0, upper] with cost(X) <= M (cost monotone non-decreasing; X=0 valid), using a safe upper bound max_i P_i*(2*isqrt(M//P_i)+1).
Add leftover handling: answer = units(X) + (M - cost(X))//(X+1).
Write final Python program with sys.stdin fast input; verified against samples 1 and 2 and brute-force on small random inputs.
